strings.MediaEngine.Fat12HybridSource: A hybrid disk image cannot be safely reinterpreted as a single FAT12 target.
strings.MediaEngine.Fat12UnsupportedTarget: The target format '{0}' is not a supported Atari ST, IBM PC, or MSX FAT12 format.
strings.MediaEngine.Fat12IncompatibleGeometry: The FAT12 geometry of '{0}' is not exactly compatible with '{1}'.
strings.MediaEngine.Fat12InvalidBpb: The image '{0}' does not contain a complete, consistent FAT12 BPB and layout.
strings.MediaEngine.Fat12MissingSectors: The image '{0}' is missing sectors and cannot be safely reinterpreted.
